## Gate Check

- [ ] DEC-NEXT-007 Live activation is recorded, or this is reversible preparation only.

- [ ] No agreement is sent for signature before licensed-lawyer review.

- [ ] Manager/agent outreach
- [ ] Agreement draft
- [ ] Legal review
- [ ] Revenue-share / attribution terms

- [ ] Agreement remains clearly marked draft until lawyer review.
- [ ] No exclusivity, revenue, or conversion promise exceeds approved language.

- [ ] Partner attribution terms are consistent with the Live PRD.
